Extension.Name: AMD
Extension.Author: Ritze
Extension.Description: Tuning options for the AMD RADV Vulkan driver.

RADV Perftest.Name: NGGC (NGG Culling)
RADV Perftest.Description: Force-enable NGG culling on GPUs where it is not on by default.

RADV Perftest.Name: SAM (Smart Access Memory)
RADV Perftest.Description: Move more driver-internal objects to VRAM (benefits resizable BAR / Smart Access Memory).

Vulkan.Name: Mesa Anti-Lag
Vulkan.Description: Enable the VK_LAYER_MESA_anti_lag implicit layer to reduce input latency.

Vulkan.Name: Vulkan Present Mode
Vulkan.Description: Overrides the Vulkan swapchain present mode regardless of what the game requested (MESA_VK_WSI_PRESENT_MODE). fifo = capped vsync, relaxed = vsync that drops sync on a missed frame, mailbox = uncapped without tearing (triple-buffer-like), immediate = uncapped, may tear.

RADV Debug.Name: Disable Hi-Z (nohiz)
RADV Debug.Description: Adds nohiz to RADV_DEBUG (disables Hi-Z depth-compression). Not a performance toggle — a known workaround for specific rendering glitches (flickering/blocky shadow artifacts) in some DXVK/VKD3D titles on RADV; only useful if you're seeing that exact symptom.

Shader Cache.Name: Shader Cache Max Size (GB)
Shader Cache.Description: Overrides MESA_SHADER_CACHE_MAX_SIZE (max on-disk shader cache size). Mesa's own default is 1GB when left at 0. Set 1-32 to cap the cache at that many gigabytes.
